examName: Operationalizing Machine Learning and Generative AI Solutions
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AI-300. Like SC-500, this study guide carries no 'Skills measured as of <date>' line — Microsoft publishes a single undated skills list for it. Re-check learn.microsoft.com before the exam. The exam covers both classical MLOps in Azure Machine Learning and GenAIOps in Microsoft Foundry, and questions frequently turn on which of the two a scenario belongs to.

domains.name: Design and implement an MLOps infrastructure
subtopics: Create and manage an Azure Machine Learning workspace
Create and manage datastores and data assets
Create and manage compute targets
Configure identity and access management for workspaces
Create and manage environments and components
Share assets across workspaces by using registries
Configure GitHub integration with Machine Learning to enable secure access
Deploy workspaces and resources by using Bicep and the Azure CLI
Automate resource provisioning by using GitHub Actions workflows
Restrict network access to Machine Learning workspaces and manage source control with Git

domains.name: Implement machine learning model lifecycle and operations
subtopics: Configure experiment tracking with MLflow
Use automated machine learning to explore optimal models
Automate hyperparameter tuning and run model training scripts
Manage distributed training for large and deep learning models
Implement training pipelines and compare model performance across jobs
Package a feature retrieval specification with the model artifact
Register an MLflow model and manage model lifecycle including archiving
Evaluate a model by using responsible AI principles
Deploy models as real-time or batch endpoints with managed inference options
Implement progressive rollout and safe rollback, detect data drift, and configure retraining triggers

domains.name: Design and implement a GenAIOps infrastructure
subtopics: Create and configure Foundry resources and project environments
Configure identity and access management with managed identities and RBAC
Implement network security and private networking configurations
Deploy infrastructure using Bicep templates and the Azure CLI
Deploy foundation models by using serverless API endpoints and managed compute
Select appropriate models for specific use cases
Implement model versioning and production deployment strategies
Configure provisioned throughput units for high-volume workloads
Design and develop prompts and create prompt variants for comparison
Implement version control for prompts by using Git repositories

domains.name: Implement generative AI quality assurance and observability
subtopics: Create test datasets and data mapping for comprehensive model evaluation
Implement AI quality metrics including groundedness, relevance, coherence, and fluency
Configure risk and safety evaluations for harmful content detection
Set up automated evaluation workflows using built-in and custom metrics
Examine continuous monitoring in Foundry
Monitor performance metrics including latency, throughput, and response times
Track and optimise cost metrics including token consumption and resource usage
Configure detailed logging, tracing, and debugging for production troubleshooting

domains.name: Optimize generative AI systems and model performance
subtopics: Optimise retrieval by tuning similarity thresholds, chunk sizes, and retrieval strategies
Select and fine-tune embedding models for domain-specific accuracy
Implement and optimise hybrid search combining semantic and keyword-based retrieval
Evaluate and improve RAG performance with relevance metrics and A/B testing
Design and implement advanced fine-tuning methods
Create and manage synthetic data for fine-tuning
Monitor and optimise fine-tuned model performance
Manage a fine-tuned model from development through production deployment
